name: PolicyAttestationManager
tagline: Every policy approved, acknowledged by the right people, reminded, excepted on the record and reviewed on time.
description: A complete policy attestation app for legal and compliance teams: a versioned policy library with owners and regulations, an approval lifecycle with segregation of duties, attestation campaigns with per-person tracking or LMS counts, reminder waves with generated reminder text and recipients, time-limited exceptions and exemptions, a review calendar with 'no change' and 'new version' actions and completion KPIs by campaign and department – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Versioned policy library with codes, owners, regulations and superseded versions
Lifecycle Draft → In review → Approved → Published → Attestation open → Closed with validated moves
Segregation of duties – owners cannot approve their own policy
Per-person attestation lists (Pending, Attested, Declined, Exception, Exempt) or LMS counts
Reminder waves with generated reminder text and recipient emails (OnAction)
Exceptions with reason and expiry within a configurable maximum; extend or revoke with undo
Review calendar with 'No change' and 'New version' actions
Completion by campaign and department, 16 automatic checks and P1–P4 priority
Phone layout with bottom view switcher and campaign picker
Canvas data-set, model-driven direct save and Power Pages Web API
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (PolicyAttestationManager data-set control + PolicyAttestationManagerPortal field control)
